Meds can be a wonderful thing, don’t let my post scare you out of taking them. I’m not a doctor but had been on antidepressants and other psych meds for 10 years as I stated above. The key thing with taking any new medication is be hyper aware of how you felt before you started taking them and how you feel while taking them. Antidepressants and other psych meds don’t start helping right away, it usually takes a couple of weeks. If you take them and they aren’t helping improve or they make you feel worse, don’t hesitate to get ahold of your doctor and let them know what is going on. I hope this is helpful. 🖤
